answer: Simultaneous attendance checks. A verifier issues one single-use reward token to each person who occupies a supervised booth throughout a common time window. Each token funds one quota for work on gale forecasts, horizon surveys, or quill manuscripts, regardless of account count. N quotas require N people present at once, costing the attacker recruitment, travel, and time; one person cannot rotate through N booths. This assumes honest staff and synchronized sessions; proxy attendance or staggered windows weaken the bound.
